everybody except Todd, who I didn't hear from, which may mean he's out of
town.  I'm flexible on time & place, but Giron's on the south side, Todd's
by the Park shops (I think) and the rest are up north, so a central

coordinate or just reply to all and we'll work it out amongst ourselves.
